title: Farmhand player command v1
description: A proposal from the language layer (rules, a local model, or the fixed key). It carries no authority: the coordinator adds request id and farm, and the executor validates the resulting intent (intent.schema.json) and selects all equipment. No vehicle IDs, coordinates or control values can be expressed.

command.description: fetch_pair: bring an available tractor and forage wagon, hitched. move_pair: move the hitched tractor and forage wagon the requester refers to ('this'; the pair nearest them). hitch_pair: hitch an available tractor to the forage wagon where it stands. detach_pair: unhitch the implement (of the named kind, else any) from the tractor it is hitched to, the pair nearest the requester, where it stands. unsupported: understood, but not something Farmhand does yet (reason). load_tractor: drive a free tractor (tractor_name) up a transport trailer's ramps (implement_name), belt it and raise the ramps ('load the tractor and secure it'). unload_tractor: release the belts and back the tractor off ('unload it'). sequence: several job commands in order (steps). follow_me: the named rig (tractor_name) follows the vehicle the player drives, with FollowMe, until stopped; only on the player's explicit 'follow me'. resume: continue the goal that was stopped, taken over or blocked, from what is already done ('continue'). retarget: give the goal a new destination ('take it to field 2 instead'). haul_tractor: take the named tractor (tractor_name) to the target on a transport and unload it there, from whatever is already done ('take the deutz to field 3 and unload it'). sell: the rig with the most cargo (tractor_name if said) takes it to the best paid sell point ('sell the grain'). store: the rig with the most cargo (tractor_name if said) takes it to the farm's own storage ('store the grain', 'put the grain in the silo'). harvest_policy: where harvested crop goes from now on, saved (destination; 'from now on sell the harvest'). back_off: the named machine straight back a few metres, out of a contact ('back the mf 8570 off'). fold_implement: an implement (kind, tractor_name) to its transport or work configuration (fold). teleport: the named rig teleported to a field's edge, only on the player's explicit 'teleport ... to field N'. mount_front: the named machine's front implement set down on its carrier ('load the header onto its trailer'). unmount_front: that implement taken off its carrier onto the named machine ('take the header off its trailer'). route: Farmhand's learned routes (action, name): the player's own driving recorded and kept ('record this route', 'stop recording and save as farm to shop', 'delete the route farm to shop'). contract: a GIANTS field contract taken, worked and collected (field, kind optional; 'do a contract', 'do the plow contract on field 12'). stop: cancel the current job now. status: report the current job. settings: open the Farmhand AI menu in game. report: save a diagnostics zip on the Desktop. land: buy or sell the farmland parcel a field lies on (land_action, field; 'buy field 12', 'sell field 12').

into_field.description: join_fields: the field the other is joined to ('add field 4 to field 5': 5).

steps.description: sequence: the player's job commands in the order said, each run only after the one before completed ('take the gmc, hitch the deckover, load the tractor, ...').

target.description: fetch_pair and move_pair. Default 'here' (the requester's position when accepted). A place is named in the player's words (part of an owned building's name). origin (move_pair): back where Farmhand took it from ('take it back').

field.description: field_work: an owned field's number, or the smallest owned field. contract: the contract's field number. unload_combine: the field a helper harvests (default: the one being harvested).

wants.description: buy: what to buy, in order.

items.description: buy: what to buy. kind: plow (a store plow our tractors can pull), truck, trailer or tractor (by the name the player gave), grain_trailer (a tractor-drawn tipper, GIANTS' TRAILERS category); size large: the widest that fits; engine: the motor configuration with these words in its name.

options.description: Other configuration choices by their words ('25m unrealistic', '25 mph').

truck_name.description: haul_tractor: the truck whose transport trailer carries the tractor ('use the gmc to take the deutz to the farm').

cargo_name.description: move_pair inside a goal: the rig carrying this belted vehicle.

together.description: hitch_pair in a sequence: the tractor and the implement just bought ('hitch them together').

carry.description: load_tractor: the implement mounted on the tractor goes along ('load the tractor and plow'): hitched first if it is not.

action.description: route: what to do: record the way the player drives from now on (start; name optional), pause, resume, stop recording and keep it (save; name optional), discard it, rename the named route (name, new_name), delete the named route, or list them ('record this route', 'stop recording and save as farm to shop').

name.description: route: the route's name as the player said it ('farm to shop').

towed.description: hitch_pair: behind the named machine on a drawbar, never on its front joint (a header towed on its own wheels).

fold.description: fold_implement: the configuration wanted, by what it is for (GIANTS' turn-on end is work), never the menu's word.

keep.description: unload_combine for the player's own combine: keep unloading it as it harvests (full loads to destination), not once.

stop_at.description: field_work with harvest: the combine stopped where it stands once its tank holds this share ('harvest field 91 and stop at 10 percent'), nothing after.

cart_start.description: field_work with harvest: the combine's tank share at which the grain cart goes alongside ('harvest field 91 and unload at 10 percent'); default 0.65.

remember_route.description: move_pair with a named vehicle: the journey's observed line is kept as a learned route ('take the gmc to the farm and remember the route'); follow_me: the player's own line as they lead ('follow me and remember the way').

tractor_name.description: fetch_pair, hitch_pair: the towing vehicle must have all these words in its name ('with the gmc').

implement_name.description: fetch_pair, hitch_pair: the implement must have all these words in its name ('the gooseneck').

kind.description: contract: the start of the contract type's name ('plow', 'cultiv', 'fertili').

destination.description: field_work with harvest or collect: where the crop (or the collected straw) goes for this work ('harvest field 3 and sell the grain'); without it the saved harvest_policy, else it stays in the trailer. harvest_policy: the saved choice (keep: in the trailer, never sold or stored unless asked).

crop.description: field_work: the crop to sow in the player's words ('wheat', 'sugar beets'); matched to the seeder's own crops.

over_crop.description: field_work: the player said to work the field even over a standing crop ('... anyway').

area_m2.description: field_work: work only this much of the field (a test area, m2).

operations.description: field_work: what to do to the field, in order (each hitches what does it, works the field and unhitches).

implement.description: The implement to hitch or unhitch (a GIANTS specialization kind; default forage_wagon to hitch, any to unhitch). Only for fetch_pair, hitch_pair, detach_pair, mount_front, unmount_front.
